title: KĀLA-YANTRA v3 launch configuration of the OpenAI Codex CLI engine, the input of fleet/kyqualify.py (relaunch plan v2.7 §7 launch line and launch qualification KV-06)
description: One role's Codex launch line as data: everything a Codex qualification receipt binds. The same schema id as a Claude Code configuration (launch_config.json), told apart by engine = "codex". kyqualify.py builds the argv from it as: codex_bin exec --ignore-user-config --ignore-rules --json [--skip-git-repo-check when work_root is "job"] -o <JOB_DIR>/final_message.txt -C <worktree, or <JOB_DIR> when work_root is "job"> -s <sandbox> -m <model> -c model_reasoning_effort="<effort>" -c approval_policy="never" -c web_search="disabled" -c sandbox_workspace_write.network_access=<network> -c sandbox_workspace_write.exclude_slash_tmp=true --disable <feature> for each of memories, multi_agent, multi_agent_v2, apps, plugins, remote_plugin, browser_use, browser_use_external, in_app_browser, computer_use, hooks, daemon_auto_start, goals, tool_suggest, worktrees, image_generation, in_app_local_automation, chronicle, enable_fanout, agent_message_board, send_async_message, web_search_request, standalone_web_search, skill_search, plugin_hooks, recommended_plugins, remote_control, js_repl [--add-dir <dir> per writable_dirs] [--add-dir <JOB_DIR> for a worktree-rooted workspace-write] [--output-schema <output_schema>] - (the prompt on stdin; <JOB_DIR> is the job's own JOB_SCRATCH, filled per launch). Every flag is the launcher's: there is no extra-flag field, so no --dangerously-* flag, no --profile and no other sandbox can be added. Shape only. Not checked by this schema, and checked by kyqualify.py before anything is launched: paths normalised; worktree a git work tree (codex exec runs only inside one) whose common git directory no writable root holds or lies in (a builder's worktree is a linked worktree: its git directory is elsewhere); a builder says commit_mode "launcher" and has network false; codex_bin executable and its version (`codex --version`) at least codex_min_version, itself at least 0.162.0; prompt_path readable; output_schema strict JSON; every writable dir an existing directory; the env_names value policy of launch_config.json, with OpenAI/Codex credential names refused; the loop roles planner and conductor refused (kyloop.py fixes their Claude launch line). A Claude-only field (permission_mode, max_turns, claude_bin, mcp_config, extra_flags, disallowed_tools, add_dirs, intended_tools, denied_tools, bash_canary, shell_canary, denied_bash) refuses a Codex configuration.

_note.description: Free text for people; never read by the harness and never bound.

role.description: Names the receipt run/QUALIFICATIONS/<role>-<model>.json (the model tells a Codex receipt from a Claude one of the same role) and the one-shot launchd label in.marsys.kalayantra.qualify.<role>.

model.description: The OpenAI model (-m); the campaign's Codex agents use gpt-6.1-sol (owner decision 2026-10-12). A different model is a different configuration: it needs its own receipt.

effort.description: model_reasoning_effort. 'ultra' (it delegates the work to sub-agents) and 'persistent' (it switches the model into persistent mode: proactive follow-up work beyond the request) are refused.

sandbox.description: -s: read-only for reviewers, workspace-write for builders. danger-full-access is refused: it lifts the sandbox.

network.description: sandbox_workspace_write.network_access. false for a builder (the launcher pushes for it) and for read-only; a job-rooted run's own choice (the reviewers: false).

work_root.description: Where -C points (default "worktree"). "job": the job's own folder is -C and, with its TMPDIR, all the job may write (/tmp is excluded on every line) (workspace-write, no writable_dirs, --skip-git-repo-check on the line); the item's working copy is read through absolute paths and must be unchanged after the job (cockpit ruling E1: the reviewers).

commit_mode.description: Required of a Codex builder (worktree-rooted, workspace-write), and only there (cockpit ruling E7): "launcher" — the job has no write access to any git directory and no network; it leaves its changes in the working copy and a proposed commit_message in result.json (schemas/job_result_launcher_commit.json); the launcher commits and pushes outside the sandbox.

deadline_seconds.description: The role's wall-clock deadline; bound, and the upper limit of every canary run. Codex has no turn limit: the deadline is the only one.

worktree.description: -C: the job's working root, a git work tree.

codex_bin.description: The program (on the campaign host /opt/homebrew/bin/codex); its real path is hashed and bound.

codex_min_version.description: The lowest `codex --version` (X.Y.Z, a pre-release suffix ignored) this configuration accepts.

output_schema.description: Optional --output-schema: the JSON schema of the job's final message (a reviewer's JSON result). Its sha256 is bound.

env_names.description: The job's whole environment, by name (env -i semantics); values follow kyqualify.py's value policy. CODEX_HOME is not among them: the program then uses $HOME/.codex for its sign-in.

child_path.description: The PATH value: absolute entries separated by ':'; an empty entry would be the current directory.

writable_dirs.description: Extra writable roots (--add-dir) besides -C and, for a builder, the job's own folder; empty for read-only and for a job-rooted run. Never a git directory, a path inside one or a folder that holds the worktree's common git directory (derived with git and checked): a Codex job writes no git directory.
